correctness.rationale: A nonadjacent pair forces all additional dual-face vertices into its unique 2-by-2 rook rectangle; thus the dual is covered by row and column simplices and rectangle tetrahedra. Relative excision yields H_2(Gamma,B)=exterior-square tensor and H_1(B)=augmentation tensor, with connecting morphism onto all bipartite four-cycles. Integral Alexander duality including the ambient orientation sign proves the unique nonzero free homology and module; the exterior-square character identity proves the trace formula. Independent exact rank and fixed-simplex trace computations for (2,3),(3,3),(3,4), 192 group elements, returned VERIFY_OK. All-n claims follow from the proof, not the finite test.

value.rationale: Complete infinite-parameter integer homology and S_m by S_n homology lattice character for canonical rook graphs, including a natural kernel presentation, is a motivated structural classification. It also supplies the first family-wide below-top obstruction to shellability for all m,n>=3. This is mathematically distinct from known two-row prism and path-grid calculations and not merely a routine finite table.
